subject: Zoning Ordinance Comprehensive Update
overview: The committee met with planning consultant Innes Associates and city staff to review the three-phase roadmap for a comprehensive overhaul of the city's zoning ordinance. The committee voted to request further council input on policy items and to track related planning and economic studies within the consultant's ongoing update memo.

items.title: Zoning ordinance updates with Innes Associates
items.summary: Innes Associates and Director of Planning, Development and Sustainability Alicia Hunt presented a three-phase timeline, topic areas, and potential initial technical corrections for the city's comprehensive zoning ordinance update.

items.title: Motion on council input and tracking studies in memo
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to have the chair recirculate a request for council policy input and to add a dedicated section tracking required studies and their funding status to the Innes Associates update memo.
